ideas.title: Minnesota Fraud Investigation
ideas.description: Investigation into alleged fraud in Minnesota human services
questions: What is the extent of the alleged fraud in Minnesota human services?
Who is responsible for the lack of accountability and oversight?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread fraud and corruption in Minnesota human services. By following the money and investigating the lack of accountability and oversight, we may be able to identify those responsible and bring them to justice.
